nodes.text:
In January 2025, the World Health Organization declared a global health emergency due to a new coronavirus in China.

 The declaration was based on the surge in respiratory diseases, including those caused by Human Metapneumovirus, influenza A, and other viruses besides COVID-19. https://t.co/Ed10WoaPIP
